views.accessibility:
- main:
  - paragraph: SUBSCRIPTION WORKSPACE
  - heading "Orchard Plan" [level=1]
  - navigation "Workflow screens":
    - button "List"
    - button "Detail"
    - button "Edit"
    - button "Timeline"
  - region "Subscription screen":
    - text: Plan name
    - textbox "Plan name": Orchard Plan
    - text: Human-readable plan label shown in headers. Status
    - combobox "Status":
      - option "Future"
      - option "Trialing"
      - option "Active"
      - option "Paused"
      - option "Pending Cancellation" [selected]
      - option "Past Due"
      - option "Unpaid"
      - option "Terminated"
    - paragraph: Current lifecycle status of the subscription.
    - group:
      - heading "Cancellation Form" [level=3]
      - text: Reason Code
      - textbox "Reason Code": customer_request
      - paragraph: Structured reason code chosen from the allowedReasons parameter.
      - text: Reason
      - textbox "Reason": Service no longer needed
      - paragraph: Free-form explanation captured during cancellation workflows.
    - text: Billing interval
    - combobox "Billing interval":
      - option "monthly" [selected]
      - option "yearly"
    - paragraph: Recurrence cadence (monthly, yearly, quarterly, etc.).
    - text: Billing amount USD
    - textbox "Billing amount": "249"
    - paragraph: Amount in USD
    - checkbox "Cancel at period end" [checked]
    - text: Cancel at period end
    - paragraph: Whether the subscription will cancel at the natural billing period end.
    - text: Cancellation requested at
    - textbox "Cancellation requested at":
      - /placeholder: Timestamp when cancellation was initiated.
      - text: 2026-09-01T12:00
    - paragraph: Timestamp when cancellation was initiated.
    - text: Currency
    - textbox "Currency":
      - /placeholder: Enter currency
      - text: usd
    - paragraph: ISO 4217 currency code used for billing.
    - text: Payment method type
    - combobox "Payment method type":
      - option "Enter payment method type" [disabled]
      - option "card"
      - option "ach"
      - option "wire"
      - option "invoice"
      - option "other" [selected]
    - paragraph: Payment instrument category used for collection.
    - text: Customer email
    - textbox "Customer email":
      - /placeholder: Enter customer email
      - text: theo.reed@example.com
    - paragraph: Billing contact email address.
    - text: Last event
    - combobox "Last event":
      - option "Billing Cycle Started" [selected]
      - option "Billing Cycle Completed"
      - option "Payment Received"
      - option "Cancellation Requested"
    - paragraph: Lifecycle event associated with the most recent timestamp mutation.
    - button "Save"
  - status
